method: Independent SQLite join on the platform and the deployed digest
query: SELECT d.snapshot, COUNT(*) AS matched, SUM(b.artifact='A') AS affected, SUM(b.artifact='B') AS fixed, SUM(b.artifact='C') AS unaffected FROM deployments d JOIN builds b ON d.platform=b.platform AND d.deployed_platform_digest=b.platform_digest GROUP BY d.snapshot ORDER BY d.snapshot
